\newcommand{\CapPipeline}{{\bf Study design.} Each 2048 $\times$ 2048 FIVES image is contrast-enhanced (CLAHE) and passed to one of four model families. All probability maps are enlarged to 2048 by bilinear interpolation, thresholded at a value chosen on the validation set, and scored against the original masks inside a field-of-view (FOV) mask. Oracle-prompted SAM uses prompts from each image's own ground truth and is reported separately. LoRA: low-rank adaptation; BCE: binary cross-entropy; P, R: precision, recall; NSD: normalized surface Dice.}
\newcommand{\CapAudit}{{\bf Data audit examples.} (A) Two byte-identical training images with different masks: 512 $\times$ 512 native-resolution window with the most disagreement (white box), chosen automatically (grey: vessel in both masks; orange, blue: vessel in one mask only). (B) One of \NEmptyMasks{} training masks with no vessel pixels; inset: the same image with its green channel contrast-stretched inside the eye (outside set to black), in which the optic disc is visible but the vessels barely are. (C) A training and a test image of the same eye, with their masks overlaid (colours as in A). (D) A mask with an annotation line along the image border, outside the eye (orange, thickened for visibility), and the fitted FOV boundary (black). In every image panel the area outside the FOV is pixelated, so burned-in text markings are not legible.}
\newcommand{\CapThreshold}{{\bf Thin-vessel recall against the threshold (test set).} Centreline recall of thin vessels (radius $<$ 3 px at 2048) for thresholds 0.05--0.95. Lines: mean over \NSeeds{} training seeds of each seed's mean over the \NTestImages{} test images; bands: range across seeds. (A) The four CNNs. (B) Fine-tuned SAM with U-Net as reference; the overlapping-tile curve (dashed, hollow markers) uses the same three models as the tiled curve.}
\newcommand{\CapAblation}{{\bf 2 $\times$ 2 ablation of attention gates and multi-scale blocks (test set).} (A--C) Main effects and interaction for six metrics, with 95\% bootstrap confidence intervals over the \NTestImages{} test images (each image averaged over seeds), at the validation-selected thresholds (filled circles) and at a fixed threshold of 0.5 (open squares); clDice and NSD exist only at the validation-selected thresholds. (D, E) Thin-vessel recall of each training seed (markers) and the seed mean (bar) under each threshold rule. The intervals in A--C resample images and do not include training-seed variability, which D and E show.}
\newcommand{\CapSam}{{\bf Whole-image and tiled SAM (test set).} (A) Centreline recall by vessel width for each training seed (markers; bar: seed mean). Dotted and dash-dot lines: the test ground truth pushed through the 512 and 256 output grids and back to 2048 (mask-resampling references; context, not upper bounds). (B) Dice and NSD per seed. Hollow markers: overlapping-tile inference with the tiled models. U-Net is shown for reference.}
\newcommand{\CapTradeoff}{{\bf Dice does not track thin-vessel recall.} (A, B) Test Dice against test thin-vessel recall, one marker per training seed. (C, D) The checkpoint-selection criterion (best validation Dice at threshold 0.5) against validation thin-vessel recall at the chosen threshold, one marker per training run; overlapping-tile inference has no checkpoint of its own and is omitted from C and D. Axes are shared within each row. Dice spans a much narrower range than thin-vessel recall.}
\newcommand{\CapQualitative}{{\bf Qualitative examples (test set, seed-0 models).} One test image per disease category, drawn at random with a fixed seed. Left: original image (not contrast-enhanced) with the analysed window (white box; area outside the FOV pixelated); crop: the 256 $\times$ 256 native-resolution window of the original image with the most thin-vessel ground-truth centreline, chosen automatically. Error maps (grey true positive, orange false positive, blue false negative) at each model's validation-selected threshold for the U-Net, the Multi-Scale U-Net (lowest CNN thin-vessel recall) and the two SAM configurations; all seven configurations are shown in S3 Fig.}
\newcommand{\CapCost}{{\bf Inference cost and thin-vessel recall.} Inference time per image on one NVIDIA L40S (seed-0 models, batch of one, log scale) against test thin-vessel recall (marker: seed mean; vertical bar: range across \NSeeds{} seeds). Circles: CNNs; triangles: SAM (hollow: overlapping tiles).}
\newcommand{\CapThresholdVal}{{\bf Thin-vessel recall against the threshold (validation set).} As in the test-set figure, on the \NVal{} validation images.}
\newcommand{\CapPrecisionThin}{{\bf Thin-vessel recall against overall precision (test set).} Post hoc. Each curve joins the operating points of one configuration at thresholds 0.05--0.95 (step 0.01; mean over \NSeeds{} seeds of the means over \NTestImages{} images); marker: threshold 0.5. Curves further up at the same precision recover more thin-vessel centreline. (A) The four CNNs. (B) The SAM configurations and the U-Net.}
\newcommand{\CapDisease}{{\bf Results by disease category (test set).} Dice (top) and thin-vessel recall (bottom) per category; marker: seed mean; bar: standard deviation across \NSeeds{} seeds (other figures show the range across seeds).}
\newcommand{\CapTraining}{{\bf Validation Dice during training.} Validation Dice (2048, threshold 0.5, inside the FOV) per epoch for every training run (colour: model; line style: seed), from the saved training logs; dashed vertical line: the 150-epoch limit. (A) The four CNNs. (B) Tiled and whole-image SAM; \NSAMTiledAtCap{} tiled and \NSAMWholeAtCap{} whole-image runs reached the limit.}
\newcommand{\CapBlandAltman}{{\bf Image-derived vessel measures.} Bland--Altman plots of vessel density and fractal dimension, predicted minus ground truth against their mean (per-image values averaged over seeds); solid line: mean difference; dashed: 95\% limits of agreement.}
\newcommand{\CapSiQualitative}{{\bf All qualitative test images.} The eight test images (two per category, drawn at random with a fixed seed), native-resolution crops with the most thin-vessel centreline, error maps of every model (seed 0) at its validation-selected threshold. Colours as in the qualitative figure.}
